claims.text: This browser agent turns visible page controls into an indexed action space for a natural-language goal.

evidence.quote:
**A browser agent with a dynamic, indexed action space.**

Give it one goal. [TypeSafe's Jev](https://docs.typesafe.ai/introduction) picks an operation and an element. A small LLM writes text only when the operation is `TYPE_TEXT`.

Every observation produces a new element table:

```text
[1] button    Change ticket type · Round trip
[2] combobox  Where from?        · San Francisco
[3] combobox  Where to?          · empty
[4] textbox   Departure          · empty
...
```

The operations are `CLICK`, `TYPE_TEXT`, `SELECT`, `SCROLL_UP`, `SCROLL_DOWN`, `WAIT`, `DONE`, and `BLOCKED`. Only supported operations and targets are offered.

claims.text: Jev chooses the operation and compatible element in one request; a separate small LLM generates text for TYPE_TEXT.

evidence.quote: Give it one goal. [TypeSafe's Jev](https://docs.typesafe.ai/introduction) picks an operation and an element. A small LLM writes text only when the operation is `TYPE_TEXT`.

Target questions are speculative. If the operation is `CLICK`, only `click_target` can execute. Two decisions, **one network round trip**. Each target head contains only compatible elements. Native dropdown choices carry an observed element/option index.

claims.text: Use the local inspector or Python Agent interface, with Chrome connected through Browser Harness and separate decision and text-model credentials.

evidence.quote:
# Add TYPESAFE_API_KEY and TEXT_MODEL_API_KEY.
uv run jev
```

Open **http://127.0.0.1:8766** and click **Start demo → Run automatically**. The inspector shows numbered elements, operation probabilities, target probabilities, and executed actions. **Choose next** pauses before execution.

Chrome connects through [Browser Harness](https://github.com/browser-use/browser-harness), installed by `uv sync`. Run `uv run browser-harness --doctor` if it needs connecting. Allow remote debugging in Chrome when prompted.

`TEXT_MODEL_API_KEY` is an OpenRouter key in the example configuration. The current demo uses `inception/mercury-2.5` with reasoning disabled. Gemini, GLM, and DeepSeek can also use the OpenAI-compatible text helper; configure the appropriate model, endpoint, and reasoning setting.

## Use the library

```python
from jev_ultrafast import Agent

with Agent(
    "https://www.google.com/travel/flights?hl=en",
    "Find one-way flights from Zurich to London on September 20, 2026, "
    "for one adult in economy. Stop when matching flight options are visible.",
) as agent:
    for state in agent.run():
        print(state["elapsed_ms"], state["status"])
```

Run with `uv run --env-file .env python your_script.py`. The same policy can run a different task:

claims.text: DONE still needs outcome verification. Frames, shadow roots, uploads and pop-up tabs are outside the MVP; reported timings cover specific tasks.

evidence.quote:
In six alternating runs with identical models and settings, both versions passed **3/3**. Median task time went from **9.450 s → 7.092 s**, a **25% reduction**; median browser protocol calls went from **1,092 → 101**. This is three repeats of one task on one browser profile, not a general reliability benchmark.

The same policy opened the requested Wikipedia article in **2.798 s** and passed a local hotel search/filter task in **1.896 s**. Runs, failures, source hashes, and measurement boundaries are in [performance.md](docs/performance.md).

A `DONE` choice still requires independent outcome verification. The DOM reader handles common HTML and ARIA controls, not the full accessible-name specification. Shadow roots, frames, canvas, uploads, pop-up tabs, nested scrolling, and arbitrary keyboard widgets remain outside this MVP. Owned tabs share the existing Chrome profile.

sections.heading: Amaç ve hedef kitle

sections.heading: Jev’in rolü
sections.text: Jev tek istekte işlemi ve uygun öğeyi seçer; ayrı bir küçük LLM yalnızca TYPE_TEXT için metin üretir.

sections.heading: Kullanım
sections.text: Yerel inceleme arayüzü veya Python Agent kullanılır; Chrome, Browser Harness ile bağlanır, karar ve metin modellerinin kimlik bilgileri ayrı ayarlanır.

sections.heading: Kapsam ve sınırlar
sections.text: DONE sonucu yine doğrulanmalıdır. Çerçeveler, shadow root, yüklemeler ve açılır sekmeler MVP dışındadır; yayımlanan süreler belirli görevlere aittir.

it.title: Jev Ultrafast: browser guidato da controlli indicizzati
it.h1: Jev Ultrafast: browser guidato da controlli indicizzati
it.description: Jev Ultrafast usa Jev per scegliere operazioni ed elementi del browser e un piccolo LLM per generare il testo da digitare.
it.summary: L'agente trasforma i controlli visibili in uno spazio di azioni indicizzato per seguire un obiettivo in linguaggio naturale. Jev sceglie operazione ed elemento compatibile in una richiesta; un LLM separato genera testo solo per TYPE_TEXT.

sections.heading: Scopo e destinatari
sections.text: L'agente trasforma i controlli visibili in uno spazio di azioni indicizzato per seguire un obiettivo in linguaggio naturale.

sections.heading: Ruolo di Jev
sections.text: Jev sceglie operazione ed elemento compatibile in una richiesta; un LLM separato genera testo solo per TYPE_TEXT.

sections.heading: Come si usa
sections.text: Si usa l'ispettore locale o Python Agent, con Chrome collegato tramite Browser Harness e credenziali separate per decisioni e testo.

sections.heading: Ambito e limiti
sections.text: DONE richiede comunque la verifica del risultato. Frame, shadow root, caricamenti e schede a comparsa sono fuori dal MVP; i tempi pubblicati riguardano compiti specifici.
